// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
    const int DIM_VAL = 16;
    const int BF16_PER_WORD = 4;
    
    // Known dimensions from the baseline profile (41x512x512)
    int m_rows = 41; 
    int n_cols = 512;
    
    // Tiling logic: don't tile M, don't tile K, tile N in blocks of 64
    int tiles_I = (m_rows + DIM_VAL - 1) / DIM_VAL; // 48 / 16 = 3
    int pad_I = tiles_I * DIM_VAL - m_rows; // 48 - 41 = 7
    int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM_VAL; // 512 / 16 = 32
    int GK = MATMUL_K / 32;

    // Pre-stage A scales: the hardware loop uses i_bound=tiles_I (48 rows), 
    // so we format the DRAM scales into a dense [GK][48] array.
    uint8_t A_scales_block[16][48];
    memset(A_scales_block, 0, sizeof(A_scales_block));
    for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_scales_block[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][0], m_rows);
    }

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < n_cols; j0 += 64) {
        int tiles_J = 64 / DIM_VAL; // 4
        int pad_J = 0; // 64 is exactly divisible by 16

        // Pre-stage B scales for this 64-column tile
        uint8_t B_scales_block[16][64];
        memset(B_scales_block, 0, sizeof(B_scales_block));
        for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++) {
            memcpy(&B_scales_block[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0], 64);
        }

        // Pre-stage MVOUT requantizer scale factors 
        uint8_t scale_factors_block[48][4];
        memset(scale_factors_block, 0, sizeof(scale_factors_block));
        for (int i = 0; i < m_rows; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                scale_factors_block[i][j] = scale_factors[i][(j0 / DIM_VAL) + j];
            }
        }

        // 1. Config EX: WEIGHT_STATIONARY, formats: act=0, wgt=0, out=3 (BF16), uselut=0
        gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

        // 2. Load scales for A (sel=0) and B (sel=1) sequentially
        gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_scales_block, sizeof(A_scales_block), 0);
        gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_scales_block, sizeof(B_scales_block), 1);

        // 3. (Optional) Load LUTs -> Not required since uselut=0
        
        // 4. MVIN A and B tiles
        uint32_t a_base = 0;
        uint32_t b_base = 4 * 2048 - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM_VAL;

        gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(uint8_t));
        for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
                void* dram_ptr = (void*)(((uint8_t*)A_in) + (i * DIM_VAL) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM_VAL);
                gemmini_extended_mvin(dram_ptr, a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM_VAL, DIM_VAL, DIM_VAL);
            }
        }

        gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(uint8_t));
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
                void* dram_ptr = (void*)(((uint8_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM_VAL) * MATMUL_N + j0 + j * DIM_VAL);
                // Correctly place B at b_base + (j*tiles_K + k)*DIM mapped directly
                gemmini_extended_mvin(dram_ptr, b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM_VAL, DIM_VAL, DIM_VAL);
            }
        }

        // 5. Config MVOUT bounds and requantizer address
        gemmini_config_st(64 * 2); 
        gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors_block, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

        // 6. Compute block via WS hardware loop
        int SPAD_DEST = 128;
        gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_I, pad_J, 0, 
                             a_base, 4 * 2048, 0, SPAD_DEST, 
                             false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

        // 7. Drain BF16-packed SMEM outputs to DRAM
        for (int r = 0; r < m_rows; r++) {
            // j0 steps exactly by 64 columns, divided by 4 per uint64_t gives absolute index offset
            gemmini_mx_read_smem((uint64_t)&C_hw[r][j0 / BF16_PER_WORD], SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * 64, 64);
        }
        
        // 8. Memory barrier
        gemmini_fence();
    }
}
